title: European Nations State Their Vision for the Future of European Security
summary_en: A group of 40 European states making up the vast majority of the continent just adopted the “Declaration on key principles of European security.” Europeans are proactively putting on the record their vision of security, pushing back on Russia.
title_cn: European Nations State Their Vision for the Future of European Security

title: Resilience and Reform: U.S.-China Relations and the Global Economic Order
summary_en: In this collection of survey results and essays from the U.S.-China Global Economic Order (GEO) Dialogue, participants examine how Chinese and international experts view the trade truce, export controls, WTO reform, and the future of the global economy.
title_cn: Resilience and Reform: U.S.-China Relations and the Global Economic Order

title: Foreign Policy in the American Heartland: Issues for the 120th Congress
summary_en: A new CSIS survey on U.S. foreign policy with registered voters across seven battleground states provides fresh insights into the preferences of a group that could determine the future direction of American foreign policy more than any other group of voters.
title_cn: Foreign Policy in the American Heartland: Issues for the 120th Congress
